bias_guard: Do not use, seek, or infer any earlier review or revision context; judge only the current paper source and compiled PDF.

scope.included_material: All files input from tables/ and figures/ that form part of the manuscript, plus the bibliography as needed

restrictions.preserve: All negative results, scope limitations, facts and numerics
restrictions.unknown_reporting_details: Record as open items rather than inferring that the manuscript fails to specify them

requested_output: Overall score from 1 to 10, with 6 weak accept and 7 accept
Ranked critical, major, and minor weaknesses
Actionable writing-only fixes for critical and major weaknesses
Missing references, if any, without speculative citation changes
Visual review of figure readability, caption match, layout, float placement, table sizing, and style
Specific opportunities in calibration documentation, stream provenance wording, visual polish, float placement, and repetition
